notablePrerequisites: Grima Wormtongue does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Grima Wormtongue by tapping it and sacrificing Shield Sphere.
When Shield Sphere dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Shield Sphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Grima Wormtongue ability, causing target player to lose 1 life.
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
Repeat.
